verdicts.evidence: The sign-up panel has only "Your name" and "Home landing" fields above Sign up, with no email or phone field, and the small print does say "We send one short note when the timetable changes."
At the right of Figure 1 there is a rounded bar in saturated blue, about the same blue and corner radius as the Sign up button.
Figure 1 is flat rectangles on a pale blue band, with no visible ramp, roof, bench or kiosk, while the copy and caption describe those things and low tide.
"Home landing" is drawn as a plain empty text input, the same as "Your name", with no dropdown arrow or list of options.
